job.title: Staff Software Engineer - Privileged Access Management (PAM)
job.pay_full: $180,000 – $247,000 a year base salary (for candidates in CA excluding the SF Bay Area, CO, IL, NY and WA), plus equity where applicable, bonus and benefits

details.about: Okta is an identity platform: the Okta Identity Cloud securely connects the right people to the right technologies at the right time, with over 14,000 customers, 7,000+ app integrations and well over 200 million registered users. Okta Privileged Access Management (PAM) is an identity-centric product for privileged access, built on a Zero Trust architecture for the modern cloud. The team ships weekly, with individual ownership, and is hiring a staff-level full-stack engineer.
duties: Use AI pair-programming tools and LLMs (such as Copilot and Claude) to speed up development of enterprise-grade PAM products
Design, develop and deliver cloud-based privileged access management solutions with other engineering teams
Build and maintain end-to-end features with modern JavaScript and cloud-native backend technologies
Lead technical design for key initiatives, driving quality, scalability and maintainability
Build reusable, performant UI components for a no-code builder experience
Drive evaluation, development and rollout of new features and shared platform components
Run design and code reviews covering scalability, redundancy and multi-tenancy, and write thorough unit and functional tests
Monitor, troubleshoot and fix the team's services; find and resolve performance bottlenecks
Mentor junior developers and work with architects, QA, product owners, security and operations engineers
needs: Proven expertise using AI development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude) across the software development lifecycle while keeping code quality high
Extensive experience developing cloud-based security software
Experience architecting, implementing, tuning and debugging large enterprise cloud deployments
Good grasp of computer science fundamentals such as data structures and algorithms
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
9+ years of programming in a modern language like Go, Java or C++, especially backend services (Go preferred, not mandatory)
Good knowledge of modern frontend JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue
4+ years with PostgreSQL or an equivalent relational database
Experience with AWS, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Kinesis, Kafka and Docker
Knowledge of network security, authentication and authorization
nice: Designing and querying databases with optimization in mind
details.benefits: Base salary $180,000 – $247,000 a year for candidates in California (excluding the San Francisco Bay Area), Colorado, Illinois, New York and Washington; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience and location. Okta also offers equity (where applicable), a bonus, and benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k), a flexible spending account and paid leave, including PTO and parental leave.
notes: Hybrid: in the office 2 days a week
In-person onboarding in San Francisco, CA during the first week
Reasonable accommodations are available for the application, interview and onboarding process
